description: Create a separate employee identity database, first-party Accounts app, and shared SSO for Marketing, Sales Advantage, and Codecamp Advantage, including migration of existing Codecamp accounts.
deviation_notes: Codecamp SSO shipped on 2026-07-20 via build 38c3f0c0; observation window and legacy-auth retirement (Tasks 48) remain gated on operator signoff. Final documentation (Task 49 publish + graph/doctor gates) pending post-cutover run.

sprint.goal: Deliver one employee account and app-scoped role system for Marketing, Sales Advantage, and Codecamp Advantage, backed by a separate company identity database and shared SSO, while migrating existing Codecamp accounts without losing access, identity mappings, or product progress—and without introducing schools, licensing, or customer accounts.
